description:
Activate Thopter Squadron by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.

uses.name: Thopter Squadron
uses.cardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
